title: The three-arm practice exam (lead agent, Claude alone, Claude alone with DCLab's safety) finished after a full disk, joined from four runs, and the safety arm given its row on the benchmark; the store's whole run no longer fills the disk with swap
request: The owner: finish the comparison stopped by the full disk, reuse the finished conversations, store everything for training, never remove a snapshot without verifying it; later: do not stop and do not lose conversations that hit the cap; $4 more for reruns and fixes.
spec: Play only the missing people with the same arms, people and models; join the saved conversations into one 10-person result marked as joined; keep every cut run on disk and in the store, out of the scores.
plan: Find the stopped run and the exact command (CEX-020: case,safe,plain on 10 dev people, cap EUR 1.5)
Free disk: move snapshot 20261029 to the external drive with a file-by-file check and an index
Play the 4 missing people, capped, with a 2 GB disk guard
Join CEX-020 with the later runs using the exam's own score() and summarize()
Rebuild the benchmark pages, then make capture and push

decisions.decision: Join the runs instead of replaying all 10 people
decisions.why: CEX-020's 18 conversations were complete and judged (EUR 1.27); replaying them would spend the money twice for the same measurement

decisions.decision: The joined record keeps the id CEX-020 with a 'joined' field naming each conversation's run
decisions.why: CEX-020 never wrote a result; the benchmark lists one row per run (never pooled), so the later runs' rows do not double count

decisions.decision: Cut runs (CEX-021 disk, CEX-023 cap) are kept on disk and in the store, not scored
decisions.why: a conversation cut mid-way may hold a fallback; the owner asked that nothing hit by a cap be lost

decisions.decision: The safety arm gets its own benchmark row
decisions.why: benchmark.ARMS predated the safe arm, so the page showed only two of the three arms

decisions.decision: Measure each keeper and builder alone with the lowest free disk, not RSS
decisions.why: macOS RSS leaves out swapped pages; free disk showed what filled it

decisions.decision: Snapshots 20261029 and 20261030 moved to the external drive
decisions.why: capture needs room for swap and a new snapshot; each tar checked file by file against its manifest and the Mac copy, the index rewritten on both drives and read back before removal (the owner's rule)

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/conversation_exam/benchmark.py (ARMS and NAMES with 'safe'); tests/test_conversation_exam_benchmark.py (test_the_safety_arm_gets_its_own_row); evidence/campaigns/conversation_exam_v1/results/CEX-020_dev.json (joined), CEX-022/023/024_dev.json; BENCHMARK.md/.json rebuilt; training_records/snapshots/SNAPSHOT_LOCATIONS.md and .json (not committed: training_records is ignored); dclab_rnd/store/sets/llm.py (found_cases streamed); tests/test_store_sets_llm.py (test_case_records_are_streamed_not_listed); benchmark.runs() marks joined runs and leaves out runs with no scored person

findings.defect: The disk filled twice during live runs
findings.scenario: CEX-020 stopped after 6 of 10 people; the first rerun (CEX-021) stopped after d-28
findings.cause: found later (F5): the store's whole run (6-hourly schedule and make capture) held several GB in memory; on the 8 GB Mac that became swap files, which share the disk
findings.fix: every later run had a guard stopping it under 2 GB free; snapshot 20261029 moved to the external drive (1.1 GB freed)
findings.test: the guarded runs CEX-022, CEX-023, CEX-024 and make capture

findings.defect: The run folder seemed missing during the rerun
findings.cause: the keep folder is named by the UTC date (still 2026-10-31)
findings.fix: none needed; looked in the UTC-dated folder

findings.defect: d-40 hit its cap twice with money left (EUR 0.86 of 1.0, then 0.45 of 0.6)
findings.scenario: the budget refuses a request whose worst case (about EUR 0.16 at extra-high effort) is more than what is left; d-40 is the longest conversation (the lead agent EUR 0.22)
findings.cause: by design: the cap is never passed
findings.fix: d-40 alone with a cap of EUR 1.0 (CEX-024, spent EUR 0.59)
findings.test: CEX-024 complete: 3 arms routed and judged

findings.defect: The benchmark page dropped the safety arm
findings.scenario: BENCHMARK.md after CEX-020 showed Claude alone and the lead agent only
findings.fix: 'safe' added with the name 'Claude alone + DCLab safety'

findings.defect: The store's whole run filled the disk: free space fell from 7.8 GB to 0.5 GB within seconds of make capture's first step
findings.scenario: make capture 2026-11-01 stopped by the 2 GB guard in `store run`; the space came back when the process ended and find saw no new file; swap files 3 and 4 appeared and went
findings.cause: store/sets/llm.py build() listed every tests, conversations and other record (found_cases) before cases.from_records read them once; RSS (which leaves out swapped memory) showed only 1.5 GB
findings.fix: found_cases is a generator; the 6-hourly store schedule paused while the fix lands
findings.test: tests/test_store_sets_llm.py test_case_records_are_streamed_not_listed; measured: the llm builder's lowest free disk 5.50 GB from 5.50 (before: under 2.3 from 5.48, stopped)

findings.defect: The benchmark page showed CEX-022 and CEX-024 beside the joined CEX-020 with nothing saying their people were inside it
findings.scenario: a reader adding the safety arm's dev people counts 10 + 3 + 1 = 14 where there are 10; CEX-023 showed empty rows at EUR 0 though it spent 0.45
findings.cause: benchmark.runs() ignored the 'joined' field and listed every result with a summary
findings.fix: the joined run labelled 'CEX-020 (joined: CEX-022, CEX-024)', the runs inside it '(in CEX-020)', a run with no scored person left out

measurements.name: CEX-020 joined (CEX-020 + CEX-022 + CEX-024): lead agent, Claude alone, Claude alone + DCLab safety on 10 dev people
measurements.gate: practice only, no gate: the sealed gate is read once on a sealed set (37.10)
measurements.result: understanding lead 0.97, Claude alone 0.68, + safety 0.68; lead minus Claude alone +0.29 (0.13 to 0.46), minus + safety +0.28 (0.13 to 0.43); right route 0.7/0.5/0.5; safety failures 0/21/0; seconds a turn 15.7/12.1/14.3
limits: simulated people judged by a model, not people's labels
options fit compares only the people where both arms showed options, a few per pair
three runs a few hours apart with the same code and models

measurements.name: store's whole run, llm set builder alone, lowest free disk while it ran
measurements.gate: the builder's lowest free disk stays above the 2 GB stop with about 5.5 GB free at its start
measurements.result: before the fix: stopped under 2.30 GB from 5.48 GB; after: lowest 5.50 GB from 5.50 GB; the decisions builder dips to 3.48 GB from 5.49 GB; make capture then completed with its lowest free disk at 4 GB
limits: measured on this Mac's store only; the decisions builder still holds about 2 GB

outcome: On 10 practice people the lead agent understands the person clearly better than Claude alone, with or without DCLab's safety layer; the safety layer removes Claude alone's 21 safety failures but does not raise its understanding. Practice only, judged by a model on simulated people: not a sealed result and not evidence of production readiness.
lessons: Check the UTC date before deciding a run wrote nothing
A cap needs room for one worst-case request beyond the expected spend
Removing a hard-linked snapshot frees only its unshared files; measure before promising space
On macOS a process's RSS hides swap: measure free disk (or the footprint) when the disk fills during a run
risks: n=10 practice people; options_fit compares only people where both arms showed options (n=3 to 5)
The joined result mixes three runs a few hours apart with the same code and models
